source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 12.5.1 with the Did you know box on Lahore smog, printed page 277.

blocks.text: Photochemical smog (Los Angeles smog) dhoop (sunlight) mein NOₓ aur volatile organic compounds (VOCs, yani aasani se bukharat banne wale organic compounds) se fiza mein banti hai. Yeh oxidising qism ki smog hai. Photochemical oxidants, jaise NO₂, ozone aur peroxyacyl nitrates (PANs), fiza mein kuch compounds se react kar ke unhen oxidise kar dete hain. NOₓ ka ikhraj (emission) barhne ki wajah se photochemical smog ab classical smog (London smog) se zyada aam ho rahi hai. Photochemical smog in reactions se banti hai:

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Zanjeer (chain) yun chalti hai: engine mein N₂ aur O₂ se NO banti hai; NO hawa mein NO₂ ban jati hai; dhoop (hυ) NO₂ ko tor kar oxygen atom (O) nikalti hai; yeh O atom O₂ se mil kar ozone (O₃) banata hai; ozone hydrocarbons (RCH=RCH) par hamla karti hai aur radicals bante hain jo aakhir mein PAN, RC(O)OONO₂, tak le jate hain. Dhoop ke baghair teesra qadam nahi hota, is liye ise 'photo'-chemical smog kehte hain.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain? (Did you know?)
blocks.text: Lahore ki smog mein volatile organic compounds (VOCs), NOₓ, zameen ke qareeb wali ozone (O₃), bareek zarre (particulate matter PM2.5), CO aur SO₂ hote hain.

blocks.prompt: Photochemical smog banne ke reactions likhein aur batayein ke dhoop kyun zaroori hai (exercise Q.2e).
blocks.explanation: N₂ + O₂ → 2NO; 2NO + O₂ → 2NO₂; NO₂ →(hυ) NO + O; O + O₂ → O₃; phir O₃ hydrocarbons se react kar ke radicals aur aakhir mein PAN banati hai. Dhoop NO₂ ko tor kar O atom deti hai jis se ozone banti hai; dhoop ke baghair yeh zanjeer shuru hi nahi hoti.

blocks.prompt: Lahore ki smog mein kya kya hota hai, aur in mein se kaun si cheezen NOₓ se banti hain?
blocks.explanation: VOCs, NOₓ, zameeni ozone, PM2.5, CO aur SO₂. Ozone aur PAN seedhe ikhraj nahi; yeh dhoop mein NOₓ aur VOCs ke reactions se bante hain.

items: Photochemical (Los Angeles) smog: dhoop mein NOₓ + VOCs; oxidising (NO₂, O₃, PANs).
NO₂ →(hυ) NO + O; O + O₂ → O₃; O₃ hydrocarbons ko oxidise kar ke PAN tak le jati hai.
Lahore smog: VOCs, NOₓ, O₃, PM2.5, CO, SO₂.
